question: The non-selective medium commonly used for the growth of gonococcus (Neisseria gonorrhoeae) is:
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: "Neisseria gonorrhoeae" -> "requires a non-selective medium for growth" -> "commonly grown on Thayer-Martin agar" -> 70% CHAIN: "Neisseria gonorrhoeae" -> "requires a non-selective medium for growth" -> "commonly grown on chocolate agar" -> 80% CHAIN: "Neisseria gonorrhoeae" -> "requires a non-selective medium for growth" -> "commonly grown on modified Thayer-Martin agar" -> 70%
analysis: The non-selective medium commonly used for the growth of gonococcus (Neisseria gonorrhoeae) is Chocolate agar.
